name: Poppydock
en:
Easily completable within few years as {{flag|Great Britain}}, since you start with more than 1500 exported units of {{icon|opium|3=1}} and only need to discover {{technology|Hydraulic Cranes|text=link}} military technology to upgrade your port in Home Counties to level 8.

- id=\"Reading Campaign\"

name: Reading Campaign
en:
{{Collapse list|Increasing education access is key to increasing pop literacy.|
* Maximum education [[institution]] (+50% education access), the social mobility [[decree]] (+25%), and 13 [[standard of living]] (+26%, 2% per 1 wealth) is enough to hit 100% education access. Due to the need to use the social mobility decree, this should only be attempted in small or single-state countries where the decree can be used in every state throughout the entire game. Necessary [[technologies]] are {{technology|Empiricism}} and {{technology|Dialectics}} for +1 level of education institution each, and {{technology|Human Rights}} to pass the [[Compulsory Primary School]] law for the final 2 levels. 
* The Trade Unions are the only [[interest group]] that endorses Compulsory Primary School (unless another group's leader gains the [[Reformer]] trait), while the Industrialists oppose it, so plan on pushing for {{law|Census Suffrage}} or {{law|Universal Suffrage}} to give laborers the political strength to boost the Trade Union's clout, and reduce the Industrialist's clout.
* Suggested nations are {{flag|Texas}} and {{flag|Two Sicilies}}. The former due to being a one-state country, and the latter due to likely annexing more literate Italian provinces.
* The [[company]] Ericsson increases education access from wealth, and prior to 1.7.2, this was 5% per wealth.}}

- id=\"Revolutionary\"

name: Revolutionary
Risorgimento
en:
Easiest to do as {{flag|Sardinia-Piedmont}} or {{flag|Two Sicilies}}. Can be combined with the \"Broken Promises\" achievement. The name of the achievement is Italian for \"Resurgence\".

- id=\"Serf’s up\"

name: Serf’s up
en:
You need to discover {{technology|Human Rights|text=link}} society technology to unlock the law. The country does not need to keep Serfdom to achieve this, only start with it. In fact it is very difficult to complete it, while maintaining serfdom.
In general smaller countries are easier to manipulate the politics of, since it takes less buildings to foster a strong Trade Unions IG. - id=\"Solomon’s Quest\"

name: Solomon’s Quest
en:
{{collapse list|{{flag|Shewa}} is the easiest as they start with states in two of the state regions, making it easier to increase their power quickly.|
*As {{flag|Shewa}}, immediately use the ''Unify Ethiopia'' diplomatic play on {{flag|Harar}}. With luck, they should forfeit the territory without a war breaking out. The other Ethiopian states will be making diplomatic plays on one another too, but you should be able to make plays on a couple of states and pick them off one-by-one. If all goes well, you will be able to form {{flag|Ethiopia}}. You do not need all states to form it, though once you do, you will not be able to use the ''Unify Ethiopia'' diplomatic play again.
* The ''Bandit Prince'' event will give you an incredibly strong general within a few months of the game starting, which makes the early wars very easy as long as you don't get sandwiched between fronts.}}

- id=\"Star-Swarmed Banner\"

name: Star-Swarmed Banner
en:
{{collapse list|'''Note:''' District of Colombia and West Virginia are never counted as states for the flag, so you actually need 102 incorporated states.|
*Fighting the Civil War allows you a chance to gain Afro-American as a primary culture (requires passing {{law|Cultural Exclusion|text=link}} or {{law|Multiculturalism|text=link}} during Reconstruction), increasing the number of states which will take 15 years to incorporate (as opposed to 25). Assuming the United States completes the ''Manifest Destiny'' and ''Oregon Border Dispute'' journal entries, all states in the Americas can be incorporated in 15 years or less, except for Acre, Alaska, Amazonas, Araucania, Haiti (except if the player gains Afro-American as a primary culture), Pastaza, and Patagonia; all states in Europe except for Greenland can also be incorporated in 15 years or less. If the player gains Afro-American as a primary culture, all states in the Congo, Ethiopia, Niger, Senegal, Southern Africa, and Zanj strategic regions can be incorporated in 15 years or less, as well as the states of Cyrenaica, Fezzan and West Sahara in the North Africa region, and Blue Nile, Darfur, Dongola, Equatoria, Kordofan, and Upper Egypt in the Nile region.
*There are a total of 124 states between North America, Central America, the Caribbean, and South America (excluding Canada, Alaska, and any states owned by foreign Major/Great Powers). Mexico and Brazil are the two single countries with the most states.
*This run will incur a large amount of infamy and will require proper infamy management to avoid costly wars with other Great Powers. Taking nations as Protectorate's (as opposed to direct conquering) and decreasing autonomy to Annexation will be the most infamy efficient path - especially for larger countries like Mexico and Brazil. However, managing a large number of subjects in this manner can be difficult due to Liberty Desire mechanics.
*America can unlock this achievement as a republic with {{law|Technocracy}} or {{law|Single-Party State}}, even though it would not have the 'Stars and Stripes' flag.}}

- id=\"The Berlin Conference\"

name: The Berlin Conference
en:
* Forming {{flag|Central Europe}} blocks this achievement. * Can be combined with the \"Three Hurrahs\" achievement. It is not required to incorporate these states.
The fastest way to do it is to attack the West African states such as {{flag|Benin}} and {{flag|Sokoto}}, or Ethiopian/Somali states. Within the Niger region alone, there are 9 states fully controlled by centralized, unrecognized powers in 1836. - id=\"The Great Game\"

name: The Great Game
en:
* The hardest part will be fighting {{flag|China|Great Qing}} as they control 4 states needed for the achievement. You should be easily able to steamroll through the Central Asia minors. Afterwards, declare war on {{flag|China|Great Qing}} for the 4 remaining states. During the conflict, hold them off at your land border; at the same time, start a naval invasion near Beijing and you should be able to easily force them to surrender. Attacking Qing early while they are still struggling with the debuffs from opium addiction will likely make this easier.

- id=\"The Healthy Man of Europe\"

name: The Healthy Man of Europe
en:
You need to have researched the {{technology|Antibiotics|text=link}} society technology in order to achieve level 5 in {{icon|Health system|3=1}} institution. Great Britain will likely be the greatest obstacle to becoming the number one GP; team up with their rivals to liberate their most valuable colonies and states to weaken them.

- id=\"The Paris Commune\"

name: The Paris Commune
en:
*Forming {{flag|Central Europe}} blocks this achievement.
*Best paired with the 'Champagne Socialist' Achievement. You need to research the {{technology|Central Planning|text=link}} society technology for {{law|Command Economy|text=link}} and the {{technology|Socialism|text=link}} society technology for {{law|Council Republic|text=link}}.

- id=\"Three Hurrahs\"

name: Three Hurrahs
en:
Easiest to do as {{flag|Prussia}} and combine it with the \"The Berlin Conference\" achievement or {{flag|Austria}} and do it directly after finishing the achievement \"Habsburg Resurgence\".

- id=\"Tycoon\"

name: Tycoon
en:
The final objective is to produce 25% of the world's GDP.{{collapse list|Strategical considerations|Getting investment rights in other countries can be detrimental, as buildings constructed abroad will count towards the rest of the world's GDP. Similarly, it can be detrimental to have a large [[power bloc]].
If the end date is approaching, and you are just short of the goal, it can be worth it to start a world war on another continent and draw in as many great powers as possible on either side with the sole goal of creating as much devastation, convoys raided, embargoes and blocked ports as possible to drag down the global GDP, while keeping as much as the war away from your own soil as possible.}} - id=\"Victorian Century\"

name: Victorian Century
en: - id=\"We are not amused\"

name: We are not amused
en:
* Easy to do immediately by simply improving relations until you reach +25. You need to stop improving relations before selecting \"[[Diplomacy#Diplomatic_actions|expel diplomats]]\". Otherwise, the game prevents you from selecting the action.

- id=\"Agitate Elsewhere\"

name: Agitate Elsewhere
en:
Easy to do as an Italian country by inviting Giuseppe Garibaldi, and then immediately exiling him. In general, look to invite and then exile an agitator with the 'firebrand' [[Character#Character_traits|trait]].

- id=\"Amish Paradise\"

name: Amish Paradise
en:
Requires that Industry Banned is enacted before 1846 and must be enacted for the achievement to complete.
* {{flag|New England}} is guaranteed to get a {{ideology|Luddite leader}} {{icon|Rural Folk|3=1}} leader on release, making the law much more easier to pass in time.

- id=\"Authoritarian\"

name: Authoritarian
en:
It is inadvisable to combine this with the Integralist branch of an Estado Novo game as Brazil because the Integralists do not specifically favor Outlawed Dissent over Censorship, requiring characters to spawn with Authoritarian or Fascist ideology rather than Integralist. Militarized Police Force requires {{technology|Mass Surveillance|30px}}, a Level 5 society tech, so be prepared for a long game.

- id=\"Breadbasket\"

name: Breadbasket
en:
Easiest to do as the {{flag|America|United States}} since they start with the Homesteading law and are, at the start, one of the biggest producers of both {{icon|grain|3=1}}, and {{icon|groceries|3=1}}. However, note that {{flag|China}} and {{flag|East India}} are high producers of grain due to the sheer size of their subsistence farms and population.

- id=\"Crush the Commune\"

name: Crush the Commune
Emperor Norton
en:
{{collapse list|Norton will appear as an agitator between 1860 and 1880 if you have California incorporated.|
* Either finish ''Manifest Destiny'' to have California become a Yankee homeland or conquer it early, as it takes 25 years for it to become incorporated otherwise.
* Once Norton shows up, he will immediately start a Political Movement to enact Monarchy. That's a red herring. The monarch always ends up being your country's current ruler, so Norton will not end up being Emperor. In order to enthrone him, you need to give him leadership of the Petite Bourgeoisie and get him elected President (or get him to become ruler under a different political system). In order for that to happen, his interest group needs to have the highest Clout at the end of an election.
* Norton's popularity is high for an agitator, but it might not even be enough to get the {{icon|Petite Bourgeoisie|3=1}} out of being marginalized. There are many ways to increase their political power:
** - Roll back citizenship laws to only enfranchise Primary Culture pops, as only those ever support the Petite Bourgeoisie. {{law|National Supremacy|text=link}} is enough to only enfranchise Yankee and Dixie pops. Going through the American Civil War and failing to keep Dixie as a Primary Culture (which is a significant challenge) makes it much harder to garner support for the Petite Bourgeoisie, though Afro-American support might be enough if you play your cards right. It is recommended you avoid the civil war unless you have a good plan for keeping Dixie as a Primary Culture.
** - Take advantage of any events that let you boost the interest group's political power. The bonuses really stack up if you're willing to make a few sacrifices.
** - Build Government Administrations and Trade Centers: primary culture clerks and shopkeepers will primarily support the Petite Bourgeoisie.
** - {{law|Private Health Insurance|text=link}} provides +10% political strength to the Petite Bourgeoisie per institution level
** - {{law|National Guard|text=link}} provides +5% political strength to the Petite Bourgeoisie per institution level
** - Recruit Petite Bourgeoisie commanders and promote them to the highest rank.
* Once Norton becomes President of the United States, you can enact Monarchy, which should be relatively easy since the Petite Bourgeoisie will support it as long as Norton is in charge and they will likely have enough support to make it an easy law pass.}}
{{icon|votpb|w=36px}}

- id=\"Euphoric\"

name: Euphoric
en:
The technology {{technology|Empiricism}} is required to implement {{law|State Atheism}}. No IG will support the law by default, and the {{icon|Intelligentsia|3=1}} will only support it if the player is currently on {{law|State Religion}} or one of its variants, so a {{ideology|Communist}}, {{ideology|Positivist}} or {{ideology|Nihilist}} IG leader or movement is recommended.
Best paired with the 'Cult of Reason' achievement. - id=\"Hexagon No More\"

name: Hexagon No More
Huge Ego, Sorry
It Never Ends
L'Allemagne, c'est Rien
en:
* Forming {{flag|Central Europe}} blocks the achievement.
* The name of the achievement is French for \"Germany is nothing\". To prevent Germany from forming, hold parts of 9 states required for the formation or recreate the {{flag|Confederation of the Rhine}}. The easiest way to do that is to puppet {{flag|Hanover}}, once they are free of Britain. Alternatively, support {{flag|Austria}} to force {{flag|Prussia}} to give up its unification candidacy, as Austria rarely forms Germany on its own. Germany requires 23 of the 31 North German and South German homelands to form, so France can prevent its formation by controlling or subjects controlling 9 of these states.

- id=\"Meiji Restoration\"

name: Meiji Restoration
en:
The deadline year is a reference to the year the historical Emperor Meiji passed away in.
See [[Strategy: Japan]] for a guide for the restoration. - id=\"Military Junta\"

name: Military Junta
en:
Easiest to do as {{flag|Ecuador}} as they start with Landed Voting enacted.  Spam recruit and promote Armed Forces generals to make them powerful and they will start a coup to enact a more autocratic Distribution of Power law.{{collapse list|In order for the {{icon|Armed forces|3=1}} (or any Interest Group) to perform a coup, they must be powerful (have more than 20% clout at any point and not drop below 18%), have less than 0 approval while also being a part of the government, and be opposed to the current Governance Principles or Distribution of Power.|
*Four types of coups can occur:
**Autocratic coup: Country is neither an Autocracy nor an Oligarchy and the Interest Group endorses Autocracy 
**Anti-Communist coup: Country is a Council Republic and the Interest Group opposes Council Republic
**Anti-Republican coup: Country is either Parliamentary Republic or Presidential Republic and the Interest Group opposes Republics
**Anti-Monarchist coup: Country is a Monarchy and the Interest Group opposes Monarchy
*The Armed Forces are usually indifferent to any of the laws described above. The only way to get them to care about the government is to wait for the leader of the armed forces to have a trait like Monarchist, Republican, Theocrat etc.
** Since at game start the most countries are monarchies, the quickest way to get a coup is to restart until the leader of the armed forces has the trait Republican.
** To increase the Armed Forces clout, bolster them, hire and promote their generals and admirals, expand the army, increase army funding or employ people in the military industrial complex.
** To get the Armed Force's approval below 0, fire their generals or admirals, decrease their funding or pass laws that they oppose. Be careful to not push them below -10 or they might leave the government and start an insurrection. Starting in a country that already has unfavorable laws to the Armed Forces (e.g. Tripolitania) will help.
* The event is random and might not fire immediately even when all conditions are satisfied.}}
{{icon|votpb|w=36px}}
